sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Remove the outer sh:or: its applicability-only first branch lets every ship with an ice-strengthened status pass without validating gaugedThickness, netThickness, or steelRenewalRequired, while the second branch incorrectly makes those fields mandatory and also rejects non-applicable ships. Encode a conditional rule instead: non-applicable ships impose no calculation; applicable structures must satisfy the calculation and required operands/result. Also do not place iceStrengthenedStructureStatus directly on the hasPlating target if its authoritative requiredOwner is hullStructure; supply or locate the canonical path from the ship-owned hasPlating relationship to the required hullStructure owner, and use that path while preserving ship ownership of gaugedThickness, netThickness, and steelRenewalRequired.
